SELECT 'progress' AS source, l.id AS biz_id, l.project_id, p.name AS project_name, CONCAT('「', IFNULL(t.name, '未知任务'), '」进度填报 ', l.progress, '%') AS title, l.reporter_name AS submitter, l.report_time AS submit_time, CONCAT(IFNULL(l.previous_progress, 0), '% → ', l.progress, '%') AS detail FROM biz_task_progress_log l JOIN biz_project p ON p.id = l.project_id LEFT JOIN biz_task t ON t.id = l.task_id WHERE l.review_status = 'pending' AND #{canReviewProgress} AND (#{managerId} IS NULL OR p.manager_id = #{managerId})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'workload', r.id, r.project_id, p.name AS project_name, CONCAT(r.worker_name, ' · ', IFNULL(wi.category, '工作量'), '填报') AS title, r.worker_name, COALESCE(r.created_at, CAST(r.record_date AS DATETIME)) AS submit_time, CONCAT(r.quantity, IFNULL(CONCAT(' ', wi.unit), '')) AS detail FROM biz_workload_record r JOIN biz_project p ON p.id = r.project_id LEFT JOIN biz_workload_item wi ON wi.id = r.item_id WHERE r.review_status = 'pending' AND #{canReviewWorkload} AND (#{managerId} IS NULL OR p.manager_id = #{managerId})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'document', d.id, d.project_id, p.name AS project_name, CONCAT('文档「', d.name, '」') AS title, d.uploader_name, CAST(d.upload_date AS DATETIME) AS submit_time, CONCAT(IFNULL(d.category, '未分类'), ' · 版本 ', IFNULL(d.current_version, '-'), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · ', d.file_size), '')) AS detail FROM biz_document d JOIN biz_project p ON p.id = d.project_id WHERE d.status = '待审核' AND #{canReviewDocument} AND (#{managerId} IS NULL OR p.manager_id = #{managerId})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'auth', a.id, a.project_id, p.name AS project_name, CONCAT('授权申请：', IFNULL(ap.name, '未知用户'), ' → ', IFNULL(te.name, '未知工程师')) AS title, ap.name AS submitter, a.created_at AS submit_time, CONCAT('授权范围：', IFNULL(a.scope, '-'), IFNULL(CONCAT(' · 有效期至 ', DATE_FORMAT(a.expire_at, '%Y-%m-%d')), '')) AS detail FROM biz_project_auth_request a JOIN biz_project p ON p.id = a.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ap ON ap.id = a.applicant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user te ON te.id = a.target_engineer_id WHERE a.status = 'pending' AND #{canApproveAuth} AND (#{managerId} IS NULL OR p.manager_id = #{managerId})
